# Zahid Hasan Tonmoy - Developer Portfolio

Zahid Hasan Tonmoy is a MERN Full Stack Developer, Data Analyst, AI Agent Developer, and Digital Marketer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He is currently pursuing a B.Sc in Computer Science & Engineering at Daffodil International University (2021–present).

## Core Technologies
- **Web Development**: MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, JWT authentication, Tailwind CSS.
- **Data & AI**: Python, Pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, AI Agent Development.
- **Mobile & Backend**: Flutter, Firebase, Supabase.

## Major Projects
- **Flexpath**: A gig economy mobile app for Bangladesh built with Flutter and Supabase, connecting short-term workers and employers with NID verification.
- **Gold Price Predictor**: An ML application using Python and Scikit-learn that predicts gold prices with an R² accuracy of ≈ 0.9999.
- **Curious Cart BD**: A full-stack Next.js e-commerce platform.
- **LocalDrop Pro**: A P2P WebRTC file sharing PWA with end-to-end AES-GCM encryption.
- **Vortex Shield**: A cybersecurity file encryption suite using AES-GCM and Argon2id.
